keyFindings.description: The label check runs on every row whose per-digest tag the package lacks, which at this head is every row whose upstream names a tag (the package holds only the old tag names). Docker Hub's library/nats:2.15.1-alpine now names sha256:7ae34c25…, while the row (upstream already written nats:2.15.1-alpine@sha256:2ae57dfb…) pins 2ae57dfb…, an honest earlier build of that tag. So ci-images exits 1 on this pull request, its merge group and main, ci-ok goes red, and a re-run gets the same answer; the header's premise that a copied row 'was written now' is false whenever a tag is renamed or lost. Fix: skip the label check for an upstream that names its own @digest (rule 1 refusing one that is not the row's digest), or otherwise make the check fire only for a row whose digest is new, and correct the header, ci-images.yaml:8-11 and AGENTS.md.

Rule 7 compares the parsed path with the literal library/golang; an upstream spelled docker.io/golang:… or golang:… parses to `golang` and escapes it (reproduced by both thermonuclear passes). Normalize Docker Hub's implicit library/ in upstream_parts, or refuse an upstream not written docker.io/<namespace>/<name>; one helper for the Go version rule 3 and rule 7 both read.
'It prints one line per row and one summary line' is no longer true: a copied row prints label, copy and copied lines.
